description: See what DatasheetVend has shelved for a part BEFORE buying: each package variant's part pack, with the modules it holds and the ones it does not (module_count_available of module_count_total), its warnings, the source jobs and the manufacturer datasheet link. A missing part answers 'no shelved pack'. Free, no API key, no model call. Buy a pack with datasheetvend_get_part_pack.

vendor_slug.description: Vendor slug as in the component library, e.g. 'microchip'.

name: datasheetvend_get_part_pack_manifest
title: See a part's shelved packs
